proposed statement: The client wants to allow pet owners to book appointments online via a website on their phone.
key statement: A pet owner books on a website from their phone: chooses the clinic and the reason (vaccination, check-up, sick pet), sees open times and books one, then gets a reminder the day before.

proposed statement: The client wants the system to be live by the first of February at the latest, with an ideal target of mid-January to allow two weeks for the team to get used to it before vaccination season.
key statement: Live by 1 February at the latest, before vaccination season; ideally mid-January, so the receptionists have two weeks before the rush.
